propositions: Each attested gate resolution copies the entire ~620 MiB tickets tree to a new cache entry without delta/hardlinking, despite adjacent commits differing by single files only
The cache key is the live tickets-branch tip, which advances every ~26 seconds, making content-addressed reuse impossible and generating append-only log behavior instead of bounded cache
Five consecutive gate resolutions on single-file deltas write 5 distinct inodes per unchanged file (zero content reuse), creating ~10^5x write amplification on production scale
The tickets key violates ADR 0005 D2's assumption that 'an immutable SHA is a perfect cache key' by having no key reuse, causing ~4.4 GiB/hour disk growth during multi-agent concurrent gate execution
Hardlinking unchanged paths between adjacent tickets entries against prior tip, with git checkout-index rewriting only changed files, eliminates amplification while preserving attestation integrity
